case: Autoload initialization, ordered before the collector autoload
requirement: Pre-hook initialization is measured or explicitly out of scope
notes: Ground truth only -- no real coverage tool runs here. CollectorMarker stands in for the one concrete architectural fact read from gd-tools 0.4.0's addons/gd-tools-coverage/coverage.gd: the collector is itself a project autoload and its instrumentation activates from within its own _ready(). This fixture establishes, independent of any specific tool, that when a user autoload is registered BEFORE the collector's autoload in project.godot's [autoload] section, the user autoload's _ready() runs to completion with collector_active still false -- i.e. anything it does at startup is unmeasurable by a _ready()-activated collector, regardless of what that collector's documentation claims about startup coverage. Confirmed empirically on the pinned engine: autoload _ready() notifications are not delivered synchronously during SceneTree._initialize() -- they are queued and only observable once the driver's _process() runs on the first frame. Pairs with F091, which reverses the autoload order.
author: godot-tooling-session-2026-09-19
ambiguities: Real gd-tools does not merely check a boolean flag; it rewrites source files on disk before Godot ever imports the project, so its actual activation point is earlier than this fixture models (project import time) or later (whenever its addon script's _ready fires), depending on its actual invocation mode (pre-run hook vs. autoload). BP04 must determine which applies to the real tool and reconcile against this model rather than assuming CollectorMarker's timing exactly matches gd-tools' own.
